*** 
In compliance of Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we write to inform that the 
Company will hold a Physical meeting with Investors at 16:00 hours (IST) on 
Wednesday, 27th May, 2026, wherein Chairman and Managing Director along with 
Functional Directors and Senior Management of the Company will discuss the Financial 
Results of the Company for the quarter and year ended 31st March, 2026 and interact 
with the Analysts and Investors. The Credentials for the Meeting is enclosed. 
 
No Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI) is intended to be discussed during 
the interactions.  
 
Kindly note that changes may happen due to exigencies on the part of host / Company.  
 
This is for your information and record.  
 
Thanking You, 
 
Yours Faithfully,  
For NLC India Limited, 
 
 
 
Company Secretary 
& Compliance Officer
